app.name: LittleFounders
app.tagline: Learn, play, and build your future

family.title: Your family
family.subtitle: Watch each founder’s territory grow.
family.emptyBody: When you link and verify a kid’s account, their learning territory appears here.
family.territorySubtitle: Everything the course teaches, and how much is already theirs.

insightsConsent.label: Share usage insights
insightsConsent.hint: Help improve lessons with anonymous-style usage signals. You can turn this off anytime.

addKid.title: Add a child
addKid.body: You create the account, so your child never needs an email address. You can see everything they do from here.
addKid.displayNameHint: Only the first name. It is what the mentors will call them.
addKid.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and _ . Three to twenty characters.
addKid.passphraseHint: At least 8 characters. You choose it and you can change it later.
addKid.birthDateHint: Optional. It only picks the right age band for the lessons.
addKid.doneBody: {{name}} can sign in with the username {{username}} and the passphrase you chose.
addKid.privacy: We ask for as little as possible: a first name, a username and a passphrase. No email, no surname, no address.

cookies.title: Your privacy matters
cookies.body: We use necessary technologies to keep LittleFounders working. With your permission, optional measurement helps us understand which content and campaigns improve the experience. You can accept, reject or configure these choices.
cookies.preferencesIntro: Your choices apply to this browser and can be changed at any time. Rejecting optional technologies does not affect access to LittleFounders.
cookies.necessaryDescription: Used for security, navigation, language and remembering your privacy choice. These cannot be switched off because the site would not work reliably without them.
cookies.attributionDescription: An anonymous identifier on our domain helps us understand which public pages and campaigns lead people to LittleFounders. It is not sold or shared with ad networks.
cookies.analyticsDescription: Privacy-focused measurement and, when enabled, Google Analytics help us evaluate public pages and improve the product. These tools are not used to personalize advertising inside the learning experience.
